changeSet.author: Hanan
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientprescriptionmedications AS SELECT ppm.id, ppm.prescription_header_id, ppm.medications_id, ppm.active_ingredient_id, ppm.instructions_type, ppm.instructions, ppm.dose, ppm.does_unit, ppm.rout, ppm.frequency, ppm.duration, ppm.duration_type, ppm.chronic_medication, ppm.maximum_dose, ppm.allowed_substitute, ppm.indication_manually, ppm.indication_use, ppm.indication_icd, ppm.parameters_to_monitor, ppm.number_of_refills, ppm.refill_value, ppm.refill_unit, ppm.notes, ppm.extra_documentation, ppm.administration_instructions, ppm.status, ppm.created_by, ppm.created_date, ppm.last_modified_by, ppm.last_modified_date, ppm.cancellation_reason, ppm.cancelled_by, ppm.cancelled_date, ppm.other_medication_name FROM public.patient_prescription_medications ppm;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientprescriptionmedications TO report_user;
